author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹೆಸರುಳಿವು ನಿನದೆಂದು ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಬಲದಿಂದ
ಉಸಿರಾಗೆ ಕಾಯಕವು ಗುರಿಸೇರೆ ಸುಲಭ
ಬಸಿವ ಬೆವರಿನ ಹನಿಯು ಗುರಿಯೆಡೆಗೆ ಸೆಳೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಹೊಸೆದುನಡೆ ತನುಮನವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Your name survives by the strength of your achievement;
when work becomes your breath, the goal is easy to reach;
when the drops of sweat that trickle down pull you toward your goal,
weave body and mind together as you walk, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We are remembered for what we achieve. When work becomes as natural as breathing and effort draws us toward our goal, body and mind move together and success comes.
